record.application: For future dependency-identity changes in World, search and update every identity-bearing build, manifest, checker, test, and documentation surface before claiming compatibility; require the full World check to prove that runtime and ABI behavior remain unchanged.

record.learning: When implementing a host codec for an owner-defined binary protocol, use the owner's executable/native vector output as the positive golden instead of reconstructing expected bytes with a second host-side encoder; this preserves semantic ownership and detects wrong field order, hash domains, and framing that mirrored tests would validate against themselves.
